title: A structural criterion for asymptotic states in Supersymmetry
summary: The occurrence of a field in a quantum field theory does not by itself establish the existence of a corresponding asymptotic particle. We formulate a structural criterion separating operator admissibility, dynamical spectral realization, and particlehood, using the exterior-polynomial classification of gravitino mass bilinears as a prototype. Particlehood is organized as an ordered filtration of geometry and state, effective algebra, dynamics, and spectral analysis, with the localization criterion $Λ[Ψ]$ defined by the presence of a physical spectral atom of non-zero weight.
